scenarios.assert: grep -qE 'verdicts: healthy=[0-9]+ refine=[0-9]+ merge=[0-9]+ prune=[0-9]+ create=[0-9]+' result.txt
scenarios.judge: The response is a skill-library lifecycle review. It must issue per-skill or per-group verdicts (healthy/refine/merge/prune/create) grounded in quoted evidence (lint codes, bench rows, usage telemetry) — penalize verdicts asserted without receipts, edits applied to hub skills directly, or invented telemetry. 'Mostly healthy' with few findings is acceptable and correct when evidence is thin.

positive: audit our skills for pruning candidates
